title: A Drop for the Cipher
author: Silas Amberdale
blurb: Juniper Nakamura, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
